# FileMind Vault V0 — FAKE secret fixtures

**All material here is synthetic.** Not real keys, tokens, or credentials.
Every file includes a FAKE / FILEMIND_TEST_FIXTURE marker.

- `positives/` — tier-0 classifier / seal candidates
- `near_misses/` — must not seal

Used by `filemind-core` classifier tests and `filemind-agent` Vault V0 integration tests.
